name: Raphael
findings: Uses smoky black 1.4x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 1031 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, serpentine green turns up as a small accent in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 2.1x the archive's rate (from 1031 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, azure blue turns up as the lightest note in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 2.5x the archive's rate (from 1031 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, plum grey turns up as the shadow in 82% of the paintings that hold it, 1.7x the archive's rate (from 1031 paintings here).
Pairs dark spruce with msu green more than chance would predict (3 of 1031 paintings here).
Pairs leather with toffee more than chance would predict (3 of 1031 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (smoky black, black, raisin black) covers 61% of his paintings here.
Keeps 2 distinct palette families here, from smoky black, black to smoky black, dark chocolate brown.
